title: Automation OS Extension Registry Entry
description: One entry describing a single published .aosext extension. The .aosext file itself is never stored in this repo -- it lives in the author's own repo/release, referenced here by downloadUrl. See docs/roadmap/RND_EXTENSION_REGISTRY.md in the automation-os repo for the full design.

id.description: Must match the id in the extension's own manifest.json. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; starts with a letter or digit; max 64 chars.

authorProfile.description: Host-neutral profile/homepage URL for the author (any git host, not assumed to be GitHub).

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL for the .aosext file matching latestVersion.

sigUrl.description: Direct download URL for the detached .sig file matching downloadUrl, if the extension is signed (Phase 2d). The app downloads this to a <tempfile>.sig sidecar before verification.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .aosext file at downloadUrl, lowercase hex.

verified.description: true only once both signed (2d) and reviewed by a registry maintainer.

revoked.description: true if this extension (or this version) has been de-listed for a safety reason. The app never auto-uninstalls on this -- it surfaces a warning badge with revokedReason and a one-click uninstall shortcut.
